advice.overall: Market strong uptrend. Hold positions, new entries require careful selection. Keep position ~70%. Focus on main-theme pullbacks to support.
sellConditions: Break below 10-day MA with 2 consecutive days of main capital outflow -> reduce
High-volume stagnation (gain <1% but volume >2x 5-day avg) -> take profit
Sector leader breaks limit-up or drops sharply -> reduce sector holdings
Major index breaks key support -> overall position reduction
riskWarnings: Avoid chasing pure momentum names with 4+ consecutive limit-up boards and extreme-low turnover
Do not chase during opening auction; wait for intra-day stabilization
Single stock max 20% of portfolio; single sector max 30%
Watch for heavy north-bound capital outflow and index volume spikes on declines
News-driven impulse moves have poor sustainability; trade quickly

actions: Check overnight US market and A50 futures for opening direction
Monitor auction phase for sector strength, watch for concentrated sector gap-ups
Confirm watch-list and set alert prices
Gap-up: wait 30 min to confirm holding above open; if volume insufficient, consider partial profit-taking
Gap-down: wait for stabilization (15-min no new low); watch sectors trading against the trend
Monitor north-bound flow direction at open
Focus on top-2 theme persistence. Buy dips at MA support if volume contracts
If limit-up failure rate >40%, market disagreement high -> be cautious opening new positions
After 2pm, if index volume spikes upward, follow with main-theme positions
If tail rally with volume, add for next-day gap-up premium
If tail selloff, reduce profitable positions to lock gains
Collect daily data for review, update watchlist status
